text:
Dana: Heads-up — Oakley private VPC cutover scheduled Thu 2026-11-05 02:00-03:00 UTC. This is the on-prem customer with a 2-hour quiet window. We want handoff at 01:45 UTC and smoke by 02:20. Who's on deck?
Raja: I'll be primary deployer. Can take 01:30–03:30 window in case rollback needed.
Emily: I'm on rollback/DB watch. Will stand by for migration step and can trigger fallback if replication lag > 30s.
Leena: I'll own networking (LB flip + bastion access). Will verify peering and security groups 30m prior.
Michael: I'll run the smoke checklist and perf checks. Plan: token throughput test + health endpoints.
Raja: Quick plan summary:
- 01:30 UTC: preflight (all teams)
- 01:45 UTC: handoff to Raja for deploy
- 01:50 UTC: deploy control-plane changes (rolling)
- 02:05 UTC: config sync + restart workers
- 02:20 UTC: smoke tests (Michael)
- 02:30 UTC: final verification + close window
Emily: Rollback readiness: snapshot created and tested on staging. If any smoke test fails >=1 critical, we rollback to snapshot and route traffic to standby cluster.
Leena: Access notes: customer requires HSM key rotation during maintenance. Ops-bot: scheduled rotation unlock in place?
ops-bot: HSM rotation job scheduled at 02:10 UTC in Oakley tenant. Status: queued.
Raja: OK leave rotation, I'll coordinate with Leena. Important: do not rotate keys during worker restart step; do it after control-plane is stable.
Michael: Smoke tests (short commands I will run):
```
# health
curl -sS https://oakley-private-api.internal/health | jq .status
# perf (5 requests parallel, 3 tokens min)
for i in {1..5}; do curl -sS -X POST https://oakley-private-api.internal/gen -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' & done
```
Emily: Thresholds: health must be "ok"; 99th latency < 300ms; error rate < 0.5%. If any fail, escalate and rollback.
Leena: Networking preflight checklist (30m prior):
- verify peering: `rgw-peer status oakley`
- check route tables + NAT
- confirm on-prem firewall ingress (customer contact: ops@oakley.com)
- ensure bastion key available to Raja
Raja: I'll post once I'm on bastion and have sudo. ETA 01:40 UTC.
Dana: FYI — customer PM asked for a short status ping at 02:25 UTC. Keep message concise.
Michael: I'll post: "02:25 — smoke complete, all green" or "02:25 — smoke failed: <reason>".
Raja: On rollback procedure: snapshot id `oakley-snap-20261105-0130` in vault. Steps:
1) route traffic to standby cluster (Leena)
2) apply snapshot to new nodes (Emily)
3) verify read-only consistency
4) bring back control plane when ready
Raja: I'll tag @Leena @Emily when initiating.
Emily: I requested a pre-run dry of rollback on staging last night, took ~18m. Good baseline.
Leena: I'll keep firewall contact on call. Phone +1-555-0199.
Dana: Anything else? permissions?
Raja: Need one more reviewer on the deploy PR — @Michael can you quick approve? small patch to init script.
Michael: Reviewing now. If nothing blocking, will approve before 01:20 UTC. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: quiet-window notice posted to customer at 2026-11-02T14:00Z.
Dana: Great. I'll be available for escalation. Posting final checklist in thread 01:20 UTC and tagging everyone.
Raja: See you on the bastion.
Michael: I'll prepare a short smoke log template to paste into customer update.
Emily: Ready for DB ops.
Leena: Network checks queued.
Dana: Closing prep — will reopen if any blocker pops. :rocket:
